title: Linden Memberships Term Schedule: Commitment, Notice, Cooling-Off and Refund Basis
content:
This term schedule of Linden Memberships fixes, tier by tier, five terms of the membership agreement:

- **Minimum commitment**: the calendar months from activation before the membership may end without an early termination fee.
- **Early termination fee**: the fee when a cancellation takes effect before the commitment ends, in US dollars.
- **Cancellation notice**: the calendar days between the cancellation notice and its effective date.
- **Cooling-off period**: the calendar days after enrollment within which a cancellation refunds all dues and the enrollment fee.
- **Annual refund basis**: how annual dues are credited on a cancellation.

## Schedule

| Tier | Minimum commitment (months) | Early termination fee (USD) | Cancellation notice (days) | Cooling-off period (days) | Annual refund basis |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Linden Connect Virtual Membership | 1 | 0.00 | 0 | 14 | Prorated by full months |
| Linden Essential Membership | 3 | 0.00 | 30 | 14 | Prorated by full months |
| Linden Family Membership | 12 | 150.00 | 30 | 14 | Prorated by full months |
| Linden Plus Membership | 6 | 75.00 | 30 | 14 | Prorated by full months |
| Linden Premier Concierge Membership | 12 | 450.00 | 60 | 30 | Prorated after the commitment |
| Linden Executive Health Membership | 12 | 0.00 | 60 | 30 | None after the cooling-off period |

## Key to the annual refund basis

| Basis shown | What is credited of annual dues on a cancellation outside the cooling-off period |
|---|---|
| Prorated by full months | Each full month remaining after the effective date |
| Prorated after the commitment | Each full month remaining after the effective date, but only months after the commitment end date |
| None after the cooling-off period | Nothing |

## Reading the schedule

- A cancellation notice of 0 days, as on the Linden Connect Virtual Membership, means the cancellation takes effect on the day of the notice.
- On the Linden Plus Membership, notice given takes effect 30 days later; if that effective date falls before the end of the 6-month commitment, the early termination fee of 75.00 is charged.
- The Linden Essential Membership and the Linden Executive Health Membership carry an early termination fee of 0.00 although each has a minimum commitment.
- The Linden Premier Concierge Membership and the Linden Executive Health Membership have a cooling-off period of 30 days; the other four tiers have 14 days.
